entries.label: SaintLogic — salle de Golab
entries.scene: The actual GOLAB boss factory room from AC!D2. The reference contact sheet shows a mint-green factory floor, many low cyan vented cubic equipment boxes, large stacks of pale green and yellow-green shipping crates, bright yellow rectangular border lines on the floor, orange/yellow tubular railings around raised rear service walkways and industrial shelving. Keep the rich green/cyan/orange cel-shaded PSP palette and simple angular geometry, unlike the dark Harab control room or the red-tank Chaigidiel room. Remove all characters, cards, movement tiles and HUD. Do not include Golab's bright red weapon. Show the characteristic low cyan equipment and stacked lime cargo in the midground behind one clear mint-green foreground lane.
